description: Compute the exact total for a wash: dog size + chosen add-ons, minus the first-wash discount, plus the extended-area travel fee when it applies. Use this to state a confident, exact price instead of doing the math yourself.

addons.description: Add-ons the customer wants, if any.

address_or_city.description: Where the van comes, so the extended-area travel fee is included when it applies.

dog_size.description: Dog size tier (Small <20 lbs, Medium 20–60, Large 60–100, XL/Giant 100+).

first_wash.description: true if this is a first-time customer — applies the WASH10 ($10 off) discount.

name: get_quote
